name: field-final-verification-release
objective: Prove completed field scope on one SHA through automated, backend/database, security, native-device, accessibility and cross-surface evidence.
truthOwner: Canonical product/service/database sources remain authoritative; this unit retains evidence only and cannot self-grant product, finance, security, QA, release or production approval.
journeys: all field-scoped outcomes from U001 through U008 only

tasks.objective: Run and retain all field-scoped automated/static/backend/database/boundary checks on one resulting SHA.
tasks.currentProblem: Historical/static evidence is fragmented and the current app-field test entry point is insufficient until U001 fixes it.
tasks.requiredChange: Execute strict package validation plus canonical field test/build, service tests, generated-contract/boundary/migration guards and retain exact-SHA evidence.
tasks.targetState: No required field invariant is represented by a skipped, historical or different-SHA PASS.
tasks.action: Run canonical repository commands after U001–U008 implementation; repair failures in owning unit rather than suppressing gates.
mustNotChange: Do not waive failed required checks.
Do not count unrelated app checks as field proof.
Do not mark external approvals as engineering PASS.
acceptanceCriteria: All required field checks pass on the same source SHA.
Field-specific tests are actually executed by canonical commands.
Generated contracts/migrations/runtime artifact identity match the evidence SHA.
tasks.rollback: Return to the owning failed unit; do not weaken verification.
tasks.commitBoundary: Evidence unit does not require product-code commit unless fixing a discovered defect in its owning unit.

tasks.objective: Prove native lifecycle, security, accessibility and exact field-related cross-surface convergence on physical devices/builds.
tasks.currentProblem: Dependencies and static handlers exist but push, deep links, permissions, process death, offline recovery, accessibility and release behavior are not proven by source inspection.
tasks.requiredChange: Execute Android/iOS development/release manual matrix, security abuse cases, observability/privacy inspection and same-record readback on exact related surfaces.
tasks.targetState: The final field build survives realistic native/failure/security conditions and every required reader converges without involving excluded surfaces.
tasks.action: Use physical devices and retained screenshots/logs/request/data/audit references; record unavailable external evidence as blocker rather than PASS.
mustNotChange: No Expo-Go-only proof for native features.
No app-captain gate under current Product Truth.
acceptanceCriteria: Physical Android and iOS applicable field cases pass for push/deep-link/permissions/media/location/lifecycle/offline/accessibility.
Security abuse cases fail closed without secret/PII leakage or unauthorized replay.
Control-panel/partner/client readback is exercised only where U004–U008 require it and converges on the same records.
tasks.rollback: Fix discovered defects in owning units and rerun all invalidated evidence on the new SHA.
tasks.commitBoundary: Final evidence is valid only after the last implementation commit; any code change invalidates affected checks.
